tire_step_size = step_size

vehicle2.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle2.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vis.SetWindowTitle('Sedan')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)

vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle1.GetVehicle())

driver2 = veh.ChDriver(vehicle2)

# ---------------

print("VEHICLE 2 MASS:", vehicle2.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle1.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if step_number % render_steps == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Generate sinusoidal steering inputs for both vehicles
    driver_inputs1 = veh.DriverInputs()
    driver_inputs1.m_steering = math.sin(time)
    driver_inputs1.m_throttle = 0.5
    driver_inputs1.m_braking = 0

    driver_inputs2 = veh.DriverInputs()
    driver_inputs2.m_steering = math.sin(time + math.pi)  # Opposite phase
    driver_inputs2.m_throttle = 0.5
    driver_inputs2.m_braking = 0

    # Set inputs for both drivers
    driver1.SetInputs(driver_inputs1)
    driver2.SetInputs(driver_inputs2)

    # Synchronize modules
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle1.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1, terrain)
    vehicle2.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs2, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs1)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
